idea_code_consistency.justification: The code implements only Tarjan's strongly connected components algorithm. This is a plausible low-level utility for the cycle-preserving partitioning idea in Hypothesis 2 (contracting SCCs before clustering), but it does not implement any of the proposed experiment methodology, evaluation protocol, baselines, metrics, or the other hypotheses. There is no MAP-Elites archive, Louvain clustering, external organizational signal re-ranking, developer-in-the-loop loop, NMI scoring, compilability check, or benchmark loading.
